verdict.rationale: Thoropass's own marketing says it supplies the audit itself: an in-house audit partner, a HITRUST Accredited Assessor, and third-party HIPAA and GDPR assessment, with auditors run in-platform from scoping and kickoff to final report. There are no published timeline expectations, and no documentation of how a founder books or engages the audit. Missing for 10: published audit timeline expectations, documented booking/engagement flow, auditor network or credential details beyond HITRUST, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline

citations.quote: You can have it all, from expert guidance to user-friendly PCI DSS compliance automation software, certified ASV scans, pentesting, and a reliable audit partner.
